name: Can all types of fences be restored for stability?

mainEntity.name: Can all types of fences be restored for stability?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most common fence types, including wood, vinyl, and chain-link, can often be restored for stability, provided the damage isn't too widespread or severe. The feasibility of restoration depends on the fence's overall condition and the nature of the instability. In some cases, if the damage is too extensive, replacement of a section or the entire fence might be a more cost-effective and durable solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most fence types can be restored if damage isn't severe, but extensive damage may necessitate replacement for better durability and cost-effectiveness.
